sponsors.name: Durtpoo
sponsors.description: Flannel-fresh deep clean in a sixteen-ounce bottle nobody asked for. Notes of aged whiskey, iron, and campfire, which is a polite way of saying it smells like the shed. Lathers generously, regardless of whether there is anything present to lather.
sponsors.testimonial: I have used Durtpoo every morning for a month and my head has never been cleaner. My head has also never had hair. I am not saying these facts are related. I am saying they are both true.
sponsors.imageAlt: Vintage-style advertisement: SnowMan stands in a shower wearing sunglasses and a crown of lather on his bald head, holding a bottle of Durtpoo flannel-fresh deep clean
sponsors.fineprint: Durtpoo is not a real product. SnowMan is a real bald man. No money changed hands in either direction.
